---
title: "Privacy"
summary: "This site sets no cookies, runs no trackers, and loads no third-party scripts. Here is exactly what it collects."
---
This site does not use cookies, does not run analytics, and does not load any third-party scripts. There is no tracking pixel, no font served from someone else's server, and no comment widget phoning home.

The only data collected is what your browser or the hosting edge already sends with every request — things like the requested path and a response status, kept in ordinary server logs for a short period to catch outages and abuse. Nothing is sold, shared, or used for advertising.

If you have a question about this policy, or want something about your own data explained, write to the security address in the colophon and I will answer directly.
